llm.summary: The skill is a disclosed draft building-code review helper with no code-execution behavior, but it contains a core egress-width rule conflict that could produce unsafe draft compliance results.

dimensions.detail: The skill operates on user-supplied building design facts and explicitly tells users not to provide addresses, owner names, tenant names, or permit-linked project numbers. It does not request local files, credentials, sessions, broad indexing, or network access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains Markdown documentation only: SKILL.md, README.md, and CHANGELOG.md. I found no executable scripts, package dependencies, remote payload retrieval, or install-time commands.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill is otherwise well scoped, asks intake questions, requires user confirmation, labels output as draft, and avoids AHJ-reserved conclusions. The conflicting egress-capacity instructions are within the central workflow and could affect the main output despite those safeguards.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: I found no persistence, background workers, scheduled tasks, memory-writing instructions, tool hijacking, privilege escalation, credential handling, or destructive local actions.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is coherent: draft IBC 2024 egress review for professional and AHJ review. However, the required-file instructions give reduced egress capacity factors for unsprinklered buildings while later guardrails say sprinkler-dependent allowances must be dropped for unsprinklered or unknown systems, creating a safety-critical calculation concern.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are prepared to correct and independently verify the egress-capacity factor instructions before relying on outputs. Treat all results as draft assistance for a registered design professional and AHJ review, not as compliance certification.
llm.findings: [T09] unexpected: Accepted as artifact-backed in substance: SKILL.md lines 94-95 assign reduced egress capacity factors to unsprinklered buildings, while lines 184 and 249 state sprinkler-dependent allowances must not be used for unsprinklered or unknown protection. This is not malicious code behavior, but it is a material safety concern for the skill's central calculation task.
